bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON... Combined seas 6 to 8 ft increasing to 8 to 10 ft around the afternoon ebb today. Bar conditions moderate, becoming rough around the afternoon ebb. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 445 PM Sunday, 500 AM Monday, and 515 PM Monday. The Sunday and Monday afternoon ebbs will be very strong.
